1.1.0.why: From 1.1.0 the CMS config lives in cms/ and public/admin/config.yml is gone; 1.0.0 needs that file.

steps.contents:
# CMS config (this site's part)

The CMS at /admin reads /admin/config.yml. That file is made when the site builds, from the shared CMS core
(@investorade/site-cms-core) and the files in this folder. Edit these files, never the result:

- `site.yml`: the GitHub repo, the CMS title and logo (and any core setting to override, or extra collections).
- `sections.yml`: the page section types ("Page sections" on every page).
- `settings.yml`: this site's own Site settings files, shown after the shared ones.

`fields: !core image` and `fields: !core button` use the shared image and button fields.

Shared fields (page details, SEO, the blog, Site info, AI connector, Redirects, 404 page) are changed in the core,
and reach this site as an update (CMS → Updates).
